revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Ok with Alain for the language choice. Put the Greek verbs in the infinitive form: lin3 and 10=> ὁμολογεῖν; lin8=> πληροῦν; lin9=> ἄρχειν; lin10=>παραβαίνειν lin4=> <#ϩⲙⲉ ⲙⲛ̄ ϣⲙⲟⲩⲛ=48#> ; lin5=> <#ⲧⲁ ⲓ(¨)ⲟⲩ=50#>; <#ϫⲟⲩⲧⲁⲃⲇⲉ=24#>; ⲛ̄<#ϣⲉ=100#>; lin6=> (γί̣(νεται)); lin10=> <:ϫⲉ ⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲓ|reg|ϫⲛ̄ⲛⲉⲓ:>

Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Perhaps change the main language of the text: it is clearly Coptic, with a few Greek portions (l. 4, 6, 8, 8 and 11). Line 2 ⲡⲣⲱⲙⲛ̣ⲉ ⲙⲟⲩⲉ -> ⲡⲣⲱⲙ ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲉ (ⲛⲉⲙⲟⲩⲉ is the toponym). Line 4: ⲟⲩⲛ is the Greek particle -> <:οὖν=grc|reg|ⲟⲩⲛ:>. Line 5: delete space between ⲉⲫ and <:ὁλοκόττινος=grc|reg|(ⲟⲗⲟⲕ(ⲟ)ⲧ(ⲧⲓⲛⲟⲛ)):>. Line 5: ⲛ̄ⲃⲑⲣⲉ -> ⲛ̄ⲃⲩⲣⲉ. Line 5: delete ⲿ. Line 6: insert space between ϩⲙ̄ and (ⲙⲉⲥⲟⲣ(ⲏ)). Line 7: there is an error in the edition ϩⲛ̄ ἐ̣ν̣ά̣της. One shoud read ϩⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲧⲏⲥ and edit in Leiden+: <:ἐνάτης=grc|reg|ϩⲛ̄ⲛⲁⲧⲏⲥ:>. Line 6: ⲧⲁⲧⲱⲟⲃⲉ is a typo in the edition, as one can see on the plate, the text has ⲧⲁⲧⲱⲱⲃⲉ (which is the correct form). Line 7: delete space between ⲉⲫ and ⲏⲙ̄ϭ. Line 8: ⲛⲉⲃⲟⲧ is a typo in the edition, as one can see on the plate, the text has ⲡⲉⲃⲟⲧ (which is the correct form here). Line 10: the edition has ⲡ ⲓ(¨)ⲅⲣⲁⲙⲙ(ⲁ)ⲧ(ⲓⲟⲛ), but it is the word γραμματεῖον which is intended (see the index). I propose: ⲡ ⲓ(¨)<:γραμματεῖον=grc|reg|(ⲅⲣⲁⲙⲙ(ⲁ)ⲧ(ⲉⲓⲟⲛ)):>.
changed schema; added xml:space=preserve; indented; moved title/@n to idno
Added language la-Grek; tagged num rend=fraction
Converted from TEI P4 (EpiDoc DTD v. 6) to P5 (EpiDoc RNG schema)
